settings.text:
This is eyewear unlike anything you’ve experienced before. Powered by patented optical technology, Hyperlight Optics® glasses are designed to optimize the light reaching your eyes, enhance visual comfort, and help you perform at your best throughout the day.

They don’t simply block light - they transform the way your eyes experience it.

Wearing Hyperlight Optics optimizes the functioning of biomolecules in the brain, resulting in improved mental state and heightened productivity and efficiency. It enhances attention, focus, and memory, facilitating improved decision-making and enabling peak mental performance. With Hyperlight Optics, you boost productivity and efficiency.

settings.heading: Supports Circadian Balance
settings.text: Daily wear of Hyperlight Optics is designed to support the body’s natural response to light, helping promote a more balanced circadian rhythm and overall physiological well-being. Benefits may include improved mood, better focus, more restful sleep, jet lag support, increased energy, and a greater sense of balance throughout the day.

Experience the transformative power of Hyperlight Optics®️

This is not ordinary eyewear. It is patented light-transforming technology designed for the way we live today, constantly exposed to sunlight, artificial lighting, screens, visual strain and mental overload.

Hyperlight Optics®️ goes far beyond conventional eye protection. While helping protect the eyes from harmful radiation, indoors and outdoors, its true innovation lies in what happens to the light itself.

Instead of simply blocking or filtering light, Hyperlight Optics®️ transforms the light that reaches your eyes into a more ordered and harmonized form - Hyperlight.

And because light entering the eye does more than create vision, the quality of that signal matters. Light communicates directly with the brain and influences the systems responsible for focus, energy, mood and biological balance.

By supporting the hypothalamus, one of the body’s key regulatory centers, Hyperlight Optics®️ helps create a more balanced visual and neurological environment throughout the day.

Better light. Better signals. Better performance.

Born from stardust. Engineered for a new way of experiencing light.

Hyperlight Optics®️ begins with one of the most fascinating molecules ever discovered: Fullerene C60 - a unique form of carbon that has been detected in stardust and space.

Its structure is extraordinary: 60 carbon atoms arranged in 12 pentagons and 20 hexagons, forming an almost perfectly symmetrical molecular sphere.

The discovery of Fullerene changed the scientific understanding of carbon and opened entirely new fields of research in chemistry and nanotechnology. In 1996, the discovery was recognized with the Nobel Prize in Chemistry.

But for Hyperlight Optics®️, that discovery was only the beginning.

Through years of research and innovation, Zepter developed its proprietary ZC60-X light-transforming technology, integrating the extraordinary properties of Fullerene C60 into advanced optical lenses.

Instead of simply blocking or filtering incoming light, Hyperlight Optics®️ is designed to transform the quality of the light reaching the eye, creating a more ordered and harmonized light environment.

And that changes the role eyewear can play.

It is no longer only about UV protection, clearer vision or style. It is about the light signal your eyes receive throughout the day, from sunlight, screens and artificial environments, and how that signal interacts with the brain.

The result is an entirely new category of eyewear, created to support visual clarity, focus, energy and everyday well-being.

From a molecule found among the stars to technology you can wear every day.

Discover the feeling of zero gravity with Hyperlight Optics®️

Designed to feel almost weightless, Hyperlight Optics®️ brings together advanced materials, refined engineering and patented technology in eyewear made for effortless everyday wear.

The result is a barely-there sensation that feels natural from the moment you put them on - light, balanced and easy to wear for hours.

Less weight. Less distraction. A completely different wearing experience.
